content.comment_body: Hello, I am looking for assistance. I am working with a [company_name] [product_name] and want to connect a Phoenix IL ETH BK DI8 DO4 2TX-PAC modbus coupler to the project. My main issue is that the modbus coupler only supports FC3,4,6,16,23 and what would typically be accessed with fc1/2 can only be reached via holding registers. Using the network analog input allows me to read the integer value of the 16-bit word, but I am unsure how to determine which inputs and outputs are on. I can write to the Phoenix digital outputs with a mathematical instruction FB, but I need to figure out how to read the states back correctly. I have attached an example showing the [product_name] inputs being switched, converting these to an analog value, processing it with math, and sending it to the network analog output. Each [product_name] input toggles the associated Phoenix output on/off accordingly. Any guidance would be greatly appreciated.
You may want to try this approach.

That solved the issue! Thank you, [user_name]. For those wanting to repeat the configuration on the base module IL ETH BK DI8 DO4 2TX-PAC, with no additional I/O: Phoenix inputs: 8000 = 8001 on the [product_name] Phoenix outputs: 8001 = 8002 on the [product_name] Thanks again!
I utilized the HR number from your sample. The [product_name] applies an offset of +1.

Guidance provided by another member quickly clarified the required offset, enabling seamless integration.
